title: Therapy Intake Checklist
subtitle: Capture presenting concern, patient goal, referral, and accessibility; confirm clinician review and care handoff.
description: Therapy Intake records presenting concern, patient goal, referral, accessibility, clinician review, and care handoff. Therapy Intake evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this therapy intake stage-gated verification when staff must document presenting concern and patient goal. Reconcile referral, accessibility, clinician review, and care handoff before the therapy intake handoff. Use the patient narrative, referral documents, accessibility request, urgent-concern routing, clinician questions, modality preference, scheduling handoff, and receipt confirmation. This intake preserves the person's presenting narrative, counseling goals, referral context, communication access, urgent routing, clinician questions, modality preference, and first-session handoff. Keep self-described stressors, strengths, supports, prior service context, language preference, sensory or mobility access, immediate resource needs, screening provenance, and intake disposition visible. Ask the assigned therapy intake reviewer to confirm presenting concern against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Patient, request, and access needs
sections.guidance: Capture the patient's request in their words and the route to a clinician.

sections.title: Intake readiness checks
sections.guidance: Check only items completed or routed before the first appointment.

blocks.label: Administrative and care-handoff readiness
items: Identity and preferred contact are confirmed
Patient's presenting concern and goal are preserved
Privacy notice and communication preference are addressed
Required consent or representative authority is routed
Emergency contact and urgent-concern route are available
Language, mobility, sensory, or technology needs are routed
Referral records received are indexed for clinician review
Insurance or payment question is routed without a promise
Clinician, modality, and first appointment are identified
Patient received location, connection, or arrival instructions

blocks.label: Patient questions and immediate resource needs

fields.label: Questions, strengths, supports, access needs, or urgent routing

sections.title: First appointment and clinician handoff
sections.guidance: Leave a clear appointment, open item, and receiving clinician route.

blocks.label: Intake receipt
blocks.guidance: Receipt confirms administrative readiness, not clinical assessment.

blocks.label: Clinical boundary
blocks.guidance: This checklist coordinates intake and does not diagnose, assess clinical risk beyond protocol, or replace clinician review.
